title: River Queen Voyages
specs: Class 1 flat water Cumberland River with no rapids, shared with commercial and recreational boats
Award-winning activities and voted Nashville's Best Water Activity
Life jackets required at all times on the river
Kayak single max 300 lbs, tandem max 450 lbs; pedal kayak max 1000 lbs combined
No pets on pedal kayak; pets allowed on kayaks with leash and pet PFD

Scavenger Hunt minimum 6, maximum 50 people; number of guides depends on group size
Pedal Pontoon max 16 passengers plus 2 crew; can book multiple trips for larger groups
Kayak groups have tiered discounts; 18% gratuity added for groups of 10+

10 cycle stations, motor, Master Captain and Deckhand, cooler with ice, Bluetooth stereo, emergency marine toilet, souvenir sticker
2 hours on water, paddle, 4 personal flotation devices, cooler, required safety equipment
All equipment for kayaking, pedal kayak, pedal pontoon, scavenger hunt
gap: Exact prices for pedal pontoon and pedal kayak rentals not stated
blurb: Guests kayak or cruise on the Cumberland River with options including a scavenger hunt, pedal pontoon boat, and multi-person pedal kayak. Activities include guided and self-guided tours with safety briefings and equipment provided. The river is Class 1 flat water with no rapids, shared with commercial and recreational boats.
